actions.title: Scope Set
actions.description: Persist the authorized host allowlist for Synapse tools.

actions.title: Project Start
actions.description: Initialize project scope/evidence folders and optionally fingerprint hosts from an offline Burp dump.
actions.implementationTarget: evidence.ensure_project + evidence.log_event + scope.save_scope + workspace.create_workspace + credentials.auth_process_guidance + fingerprint.from_dump

actions.title: Scope Check Target
actions.description: Check whether a target host or URL is in the persisted authorized scope.

actions.title: Workspace Create
actions.description: Create or update a file-backed Synapse workspace for an engagement.

actions.title: Workspace Add Target
actions.description: Add or update a target record inside a Synapse workspace.

actions.title: Workspace Ingest Data
actions.description: Store raw data, normalize entities, update workspace state, and return compact LLM context.

actions.title: Workspace Prepare Target Context
actions.description: Return compact target context assembled from normalized workspace entities and evidence references.

actions.title: Workspace Summary
actions.description: Summarize targets and normalized entity counts for one Synapse workspace.

actions.title: Workspace Delete
actions.description: Inspect or permanently erase one local workspace directory. Requires confirm=true to delete.

actions.title: Workspace Create Finding
actions.description: Record an operator-reviewed finding in the workspace knowledge layer.

actions.title: Workspace Update Finding
actions.description: Update lifecycle fields for a workspace finding.

actions.title: Workspace Promote Observation To Finding
actions.description: Promote a normalized observation or candidate to a lifecycle-managed finding.

actions.title: Workspace Link Evidence To Finding
actions.description: Attach evidence IDs to an existing finding.

actions.title: Workspace Mark Finding Reviewed
actions.description: Mark a finding as operator-reviewed and set its reviewed status.

actions.title: Approve Pretext Candidate
actions.description: Approve one draft phishing pretext candidate after operator review. Requires confirm=true to change status.

actions.title: Mark Detection Outcome
actions.description: Record whether a blue-team control detected a tagged action and generate/update the corresponding detection-gap entity when a MITRE mapping exists.

actions.title: Workspace Set Entity Reportable
actions.description: Set isReportable on matching workspace entities in any layer (services, endpoints, parameters, findings, actions, observations) and archive the disposition. Records marked isReportable=false stay in workspace state for later granular analysis but are excluded from generated reports. Default is true; flip to false on operator review.

selector.description: Identity matchers (key, id, findingId, observationId, observationKey, candidateId, actionId) and/or attribute matchers (type, value, valueContains, urlContains). Attribute matchers enable bulk disposition across a layer.

actions.title: Workspace Record Candidate Validation
actions.description: Record a validation outcome on a candidate observation, common to every DATA-model layer. Works on the consolidated web test_candidate (per vulnClass inside candidateDetails) and on any single-class *_candidate observation (e.g. access-control candidates). outcome=refuted retains the record but marks it retired/non-reportable when nothing reportable remains; outcome=confirmed keeps it reportable and returns a finding draft (promote it via workspace.promote_observation_to_finding).

selector.description: Identity matchers (key, id, observationId, observationKey, candidateId) and/or attribute matchers (type, value, valueContains, urlContains).

vulnClass.description: For a test_candidate, the class to update (sqli/ssrf/lfi/ssti). Omit to apply to all classes on the surface.

actions.title: Workspace Curate Candidate
actions.description: Agent curation of a surface test_candidate: precisely add or remove vulnerability classes instead of adapters blanketing every parameter. Identify the surface by candidateId or by url (with optional method/parameter/location); a url also lets a not-yet-existing candidate be created for add. Removing a class marks it refuted and drops it from candidateFor (retained + marked); the surface is retired when nothing reportable remains.

surfaceSelector.description: candidateId, or url (+ optional method/parameter/location) identifying the surface.

add.description: Vuln classes to add (e.g. sqli, ssrf, lfi, ssti).

actions.title: Workspace Export Finding Context
actions.description: Export one finding with linked evidence metadata and markdown report location.

actions.title: Credentials Set
actions.description: Store or replace a scoped HTTP credential. Secrets are persisted locally and redacted from responses.

actions.title: Credentials List
actions.description: List stored scoped credentials with secrets redacted.

actions.title: Credentials Set Auth Profile
actions.description: Store a scoped HTTP login profile used to obtain or refresh a cookie credential. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Credentials Set Browser Auth Profile
actions.description: Store a scoped browser authentication profile for JavaScript, SSO, MFA, or multi-step login flows. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Credentials Authenticate
actions.description: Run a stored authentication profile and refresh its cookie credential. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Credentials Browser Auth Check Setup
actions.description: Check local browser-auth dependencies and browser launch readiness without authenticating.

actions.title: Credentials Browser Authenticate
actions.description: Run a stored browser authentication profile and refresh a scoped session credential. Runs as a background job by default. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Credentials Validate Session
actions.description: Validate a stored credential against an authorized protected URL. Requires confirm=true because it sends one authenticated request.

actions.title: Credentials Get
actions.description: Read one stored scoped credential with the secret redacted.

actions.title: Credentials Delete
actions.description: Delete a stored scoped credential or authentication profile. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Dumps List
actions.description: List available offline Burp proxy dumps.

actions.title: Cache Inspect Scope Data
actions.description: Inspect local dump artifacts by hostname and identify artifacts whose hosts are no longer in authorized scope. Does not delete files.

actions.title: Cache Clean Out Of Scope
actions.description: Delete local dump artifacts whose parsed hosts are all outside current authorized scope. Requires confirm=true; mixed-scope and unknown-host artifacts are kept.

actions.title: Cache Inspect Generated Artifacts
actions.description: Inspect duplicate generated output artifacts and replaceable raw evidence records that can be pruned to keep only the newest copies. Does not delete files.

actions.title: Cache Clean Generated Artifacts
actions.description: Prune duplicate generated output artifacts and replaceable raw evidence records after review. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Sqli Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively score normalized workspace parameters for SQL injection candidates. Does not execute sqlmap or send traffic.

actions.title: Sqli Analyze Dump
actions.description: Analyze an offline Burp dump for SQL injection candidates and suggested sqlmap commands. Does not execute sqlmap.

actions.title: Sqli Build Sqlmap Command
actions.description: Build validated sqlmap command(s) without executing them. Given workspaceId+target, promotes every interesting candidate surface — all injectable parameters grouped per route, not just one parameter of one URL — into targeted sqlmap invocations and marks each promoted sqli candidate as under testing. Without workspace context, returns one generic command.

actions.title: Xss Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively score normalized workspace parameters for XSS candidates. Does not replay payloads or send traffic.

actions.title: Xss Analyze Dump
actions.description: Analyze an offline Burp dump for XSS-relevant request sources, response controls, HTML sinks, reflections, and manual test code. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Xss Generate Test Code
actions.description: Generate an explicit staged XSS test plan. Defaults to an inert reflection marker and does not send traffic.

marker.description: Optional 4-80 character ASCII alphanumeric marker. Returned and sent without rewriting.

actions.title: Xss Execute Test
actions.description: Run approved benign XSS reflection probes against an in-scope HTTP target. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Spec Import Capabilities
actions.description: Return spec_import adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Headers Cookies Capabilities
actions.description: Return headers_cookies adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Jwt Capabilities
actions.description: Return jwt adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Csrf Capabilities
actions.description: Return csrf adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Csrf Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively classify state-changing forms using normalized anti-CSRF token names and workflow-specific login/recovery/registration prerequisites. Does not send traffic.

workflowContexts.description: Operator-reviewed prerequisites keyed by exact form URL. Login requires a scenario, approved credential reference, and approval ID; recovery/registration requires concrete impact plus evidence IDs.

actions.title: Csrf Generate Test Plan
actions.description: Generate a manual CSRF reproduction outline for a candidate without sending traffic.

actions.title: Cors Capabilities
actions.description: Return cors adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Cors Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively classify observed CORS policies using browser response-sharing semantics. Public wildcard and uncorroborated fixed-origin policies are informational. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Cors Generate Test Plan
actions.description: Generate a bounded CORS Origin probe plan requiring an exact attacker-controlled origin plus credential acceptance for a reportable credentialed-read candidate. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Cors Execute Test
actions.description: Send one bounded CORS Origin probe and apply browser-semantic read/credential verdicts against an in-scope target. Requires confirm=true.

actions.description: Return insecure_deser adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Insecure Deser Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively detect recognizable serialized object blob markers in normalized workspace inputs. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Xxe Capabilities
actions.description: Return xxe adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Xxe Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively identify XML/SOAP-accepting endpoints as XXE candidates. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Xxe Generate Test Plan
actions.description: Generate a guarded manual XXE validation outline without sending traffic.

actions.title: Xxe Execute Test
actions.description: Run an approved benign in-band XML entity expansion probe against an in-scope target. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Graphql Capabilities
actions.description: Return graphql adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Graphql Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively identify GraphQL endpoints and introspection candidates. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Graphql Generate Test Plan
actions.description: Generate a bounded GraphQL introspection probe plan without sending traffic.

actions.title: Graphql Execute Test
actions.description: Send one bounded GraphQL introspection POST against an in-scope target. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Tls Posture Capabilities
actions.description: Return tls_posture adapter capabilities and metadata.

actions.title: Tls Posture Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively normalize TLS posture observations from already-collected SSL data. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Jwt Analyze
actions.description: Offline analysis of a supplied JWT (alg=none, weak built-in secrets, kid injection surface, missing expiry, privileged claims). Sends no traffic; never stores or echoes the token or any matched secret.

ingest.description: When true with workspaceId+target, stores redacted observations.

actions.title: Headers Cookies Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively analyze recorded response security headers and cookie flags for hygiene weaknesses. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Spec Import Import Spec
actions.description: Passively import an OpenAPI/Swagger/Postman specification, normalizing documented endpoints, parameters, and auth schemes into the workspace. Does not send traffic.

rawData.description: The specification document (JSON, or YAML if PyYAML is available).

actions.title: Ssrf Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively analyze normalized workspace endpoints, parameters, and forms for SSRF candidates. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Ssrf Generate Test Plan
actions.description: Generate a manual SSRF test plan for a candidate without sending traffic.

actions.title: Ssrf Execute Test
actions.description: Send one approved SSRF canary URL probe to an in-scope target parameter. Requires confirm=true and callbackBaseUrl or callbackUrl.

actions.title: Open Redirect Analyze Workspace

actions.title: Open Redirect Execute Test
actions.description: Run an approved harmless external URL redirect probe against an in-scope target. Requires confirm=true.

followRedirects.description: Open redirect probes always capture Location headers without following redirects.

actions.title: Command Injection Analyze Workspace
actions.description: Passively analyze normalized workspace endpoints and parameters for command injection candidates using fingerprint OS hints. Does not send traffic.

actions.title: Command Injection Generate Test Plan
actions.description: Generate benign OS-aware manual command injection payloads for a candidate without sending traffic.

actions.title: Command Injection Prepare Replay
actions.description: Build a no-traffic manual replay request for one benign command injection marker payload.

actions.title: Command Injection Execute Test

actions.title: Cve Reset Source Endpoint
actions.description: Clear an unpersisted runtime endpoint override for a known CVE source. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Cve Session Key Set
actions.description: Set a runtime-only CVE provider API key for this MCP process. Key values are never echoed or persisted. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Cve Session Key Clear
actions.description: Clear a runtime-only CVE provider API key for this MCP process. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Cve Session Key Status
actions.description: Show which CVE provider session keys are configured without revealing key values.

actions.title: Cve Correlate
actions.description: Correlate fingerprinted technology components with selected CVE intelligence sources and ingest cve_candidate observations. Requires confirm=true because it can touch third-party sources.

sources.description: Comma-separated source list or array. Defaults to SYNAPSE_CVE_SOURCES.

includeVersionUnknown.description: Opt into broad NVD keyword correlation for components without a version. Uncorroborated results remain suppressed.

providerRateLimitCapacity.description: Optional per-source credential-tier token-bucket capacity override; provider-safe defaults apply when omitted.

providerRateLimitWindowSeconds.description: Optional token-bucket refill window override in seconds.

providerMaxAttempts.description: Maximum attempts for a provider query, including the initial request.

providerMaxWaitSeconds.description: Maximum cumulative provider-budget and Retry-After wait for one query before returning a resumable rate_limited source status.

actions.title: Ssti Execute Test

actions.title: Lfi Execute Test
actions.description: Run approved benign LFI/RFI file-handling probes against an in-scope HTTP target. Requires confirm=true.

actions.title: Ssi Capabilities
actions.description: Return SSI adapter capability and safety metadata.

actions.title: Ssi Passive Analyze
actions.description: Passively identify SSI candidate surfaces from workspace endpoints, parameters, and observations.

actions.title: Ssi Plan Tests
actions.description: Generate a conservative SSI test plan without sending traffic.

actions.title: Ssi Prepare Replay

actions.title: Ssi Execute Test

actions.title: Access Control Capabilities
actions.description: Return access-control adapter capability and safety metadata.

actions.title: Access Control Identify Objects
actions.description: Identify object identifiers and privileged function surfaces from workspace context without replaying requests.

actions.title: Access Control Record Context
actions.description: Record an authorized user/role context for access-control matrix planning without storing secrets.

actions.title: Access Control Build Test Matrix
actions.description: Build BOLA/BOPLA/BFLA-style planned access-control tests from object candidates and recorded contexts.

actions.title: Access Control Plan Tests
actions.description: Generate detailed operator guidance for one access-control matrix entry without sending traffic.

actions.title: Access Control Execute Matrix Test
actions.description: Replay an approved executable access-control matrix entry across its exact recorded context IDs and compare sanitized responses. Requires confirm=true. Authenticated contexts must resolve a valid credentialId and are never downgraded to anonymous; anonymous traffic requires an explicitly anonymous baseline context. Redirects are not followed by default so redirect-to-login responses stay visible as denials; pass followRedirects=true to override.

actions.title: Js Analyze Static
actions.description: Statically analyze stored JavaScript assets without executing code or sending traffic. Runs as a background job by default.

actions.title: Js Normalize Endpoints

actions.title: Js Build App Model

actions.title: Crawler Extended
actions.description: After a prior crawler.crawl run, submit discovered POST forms with scoped credentials to extend authenticated application mapping. Runs as a background job by default. Requires credentialId and confirm=true.

actions.title: Shodan Search Filters
actions.description: List Shodan search filter names for building OSINT queries.

actions.title: Shodan Target Summary

actions.title: Shodan Company Queries
